Name: Mirror of Versions
Description: You see a better version of yourself—standing taller, smiling more, untouched by failure. It mouths the words, 'You could’ve been me.'
Choice2Effect: -1 Hope; gain item: Shard of What Might've Been

Name: The Vending Machine of Moral Compromise
Description: Glowing buttons read: 'Sell your soul.' 'Get chips.' 'Lie to yourself.' The machine hums: 'It’s not that deep.'
Choice1Effect: -1 Sanity; gain item: Salted Trauma Chips
Choice2Success: +1 Sanity; gain item: Salted Trauma Chips

Name: The Whispering Socket
Description: A glowing port pulses with green light. You swear it knows your passwords. It whispers: 'Let us in. It won’t hurt… much.'

Name: The Pit of Almosts
Description: A half-finished bridge spans a pit full of regrets and missed chances. A whisper says, 'You almost made it.'

Name: Hall of Unfinished Goodbyes
Description: Letters float mid-air, written in your own hand but never sent. One drifts toward you, blank on the outside. Inside? Maybe closure.

Name: Bureaucratic Maw
Description: Paperwork looms like teeth. A voice demands, 'Submit Form 7B: Acknowledgment of Cosmic Meaninglessness.'

Name: The Data Swamp
Description: Misinformation sloshes at your knees. Floating tweets and dying memes screech for attention. A sign reads: 'Ignore Reality, Gain Likes.'

Name: The Final Threshold
Description: A black door hums with power. Your name is etched above it—twice. The void speaks: 'One walks. One stays.'

Name: The Flickering Exit
Description: A doorway pulses like static. Behind it, you see peace. Or maybe a loading screen. A screen above it loops the phrase: 'This Might Be Real.'

Name: The Crawlspace of Unfinished Projects
Description: You find journals half-filled, paintings half-painted, code half-documented. They all whisper: 'You were going to finish us…'

Name: The Mouth of the Machine
Description: A twisted bulkhead pulses and opens like a jaw. Inside: screens, wires, teeth. A voice says, 'Submit input: yourself.'

Name: The Library of Lost Causes
Description: Endless shelves filled with books no one finished. Every spine has your name on it.

Name: The Looping Corridor
Description: You walk forward and re-enter from behind yourself. You walk again. And again. And again.

Name: The Apology Room
Description: The walls whisper every 'I’m sorry' you’ve ever wanted. It should help. It doesn’t.

Name: The Room You Forgot
Description: You’ve definitely been here before. The wallpaper is bleeding. The door behind you vanishes.

Name: The Plaza of Forgotten Names
Description: A fountain full of name tags bubbles beside a sign: 'Rebrand Yourself.' Your name flickers on and off your chest.

Name: The Graveyard of Yesterdays
Description: You step past versions of yourself buried in shallow graves. Some look fresher than others.

Name: The Elevator That Only Goes Down
Description: There’s a button for 'Lobby (Not Real),' 'Worse,' and 'Rock Bottom.' Ding.

Name: The Silent Ward
Description: A hospital wing. Empty beds. No machines. No encounter text plays. No choices appear. Just quiet.

Name: The Hall of Digital Ghosts
Description: You see your old usernames float past, distorted. Messages from forgotten forums blink in unread grief.

Name: Fork in the Real
Description: The path splits. Left is light. Right is shadow. Straight ahead? Doesn’t exist—yet.

Name: The Snackless Breakroom
Description: There's a coffee machine, a sad microwave, and nothing in the fridge. You open the cabinet. It smells like betrayal.

Name: The Discarded Room
Description: This room was meant for someone else. Their name is scratched out. Yours is written over it—sloppily.

Name: The Applause Trap
Description: A spotlight snaps on. The room claps. A voice says, 'You did it.' You didn't.

Name: The Compromise Engine
Description: Giant gears spin around a question: 'How much of yourself are you willing to give to keep going?'

Name: The Void Restroom
Description: The stalls whisper. The toilet bowl stares. The hand dryer growls, 'Leave cleaner than you came.'

Name: The Room with No Door
Description: You enter. You look back. The door is gone.

Name: The Archive of Everything That Didn’t Work
Description: Every failed attempt, every unfinished effort—filed, sorted, and alphabetized by emotion.

Name: The Hall of Inherited Guilt
Description: These aren’t your regrets—but you carry them anyway. Your father’s echo. Your mother’s weight. Someone else’s war.

Name: The Flickering Choir
Description: Voices you recognize—some alive, some dead—start singing in perfect dissonance. You hear your name in every note.

Name: The Paper Cathedral
Description: A church made of books and broken promises.

Name: The Gasping Gate
Description: It breathes in regret, exhales denial.

Name: Teeth in the Floor
Description: You stepped too hard. It bites back.

Name: The Clockmaker’s Gallows
Description: You hear the ticking stop. Time is watching.

Name: Gallery of Self-Doubt
Description: Every painting is of you, flinching.

Name: The Mourning Closet
Description: It reeks of old loss and recent breath.
Effect: Gain item: Mourning Veil (+1 Sanity if held)

Name: The Blood-Slick Mirror
Description: Reflections bleed truths you didn’t say.

Name: The Hollow Host
Description: It welcomes you with arms full of nothing.

Name: The Smiling Husk
Description: It wears your skin like a promise.
Effect: -1 Sanity, gain item: Husk Mask (disguise tile effects)

Name: The Weeping Ledger
Description: It knows what you owe. And it's still calculating.

Name: The Glass Colossus
Description: A shattered giant weeps molten glass tears into your hands.
Effect: -1 Health, gain item: Tearshard (use to reveal any tile)

Name: The Skeletal Pianist
Description: It plays without fingers. The song is your pulse.

Name: Cathedral of Static
Description: A loud silence crackles through ancient tech ruins.
Effect: -1 Sanity, gain item: Signal Crown (resist next encounter effect)

Name: Tower of the Forgotten Signal
Description: A beacon blinks out a message you almost understand.

Name: The Chain That Whispers
Description: It wraps around you like a question you’re afraid to ask.
Effect: Lose 1 Hope, gain item: Whisper Link (lets you pull Cait one tile)

Name: The Lantern Maw
Description: It lights the way by consuming what you love.
Effect: Lose an item, gain +1 Health and +1 Sanity

Name: Dagger in the Cradle
Description: A lullaby drips from the blade. You know the words.
Effect: -1 Hope, gain item: Singing Blade (+1 attack if combat added later)

Name: The Rustbone Choir
Description: Their harmony fractures bone but heals pride.

Name: Archive of Misremembered Promises
Description: You find a vow written in your own handwriting.

Name: The Salting Tree
Description: Its branches grow from old wounds. They reach for yours.
Effect: -1 Health, gain item: Saltroot Bandage (+2 Health on use)

Name: The Bone Lantern
Description: It lights only things that have died.
Effect: Gain item: Bone Lantern (lets you sense death tiles nearby)

Name: The Stillbirth Clock
Description: Its hands move backwards. One just twitched.

Name: The Limbo Hearth
Description: It burns with warmth that doesn’t reach the skin.

Name: Altar of Echoed Sins
Description: Your crimes are written here. In someone else’s blood.

Name: The Salt-Tongued Prophet
Description: They scream truths you’re not ready to hear.
Effect: -1 Sanity, reveal 1 tile, gain item: Saltword Scroll

Name: The Tarnished Halo
Description: Once sacred. Now it just feels heavy.
Effect: Gain item: Halo Fragment (+1 Hope, but lose 1 Health every third turn if held)

Name: The Cradle of Static
Description: It rocks an invisible child. The crying won’t stop.

Name: The Maw of Sleep
Description: You feel the yawn crawl up your spine.

Name: The Windowless House
Description: It has walls. No doors. Yet you are inside.

Name: The Hung Verdict
Description: The sentence was passed. The guilt remains.

Name: The Corridor of Crooked Steps
Description: Each step is a question. Each answer twists your ankle.

Name: The Screaming Frame
Description: A portrait that only shows you what you were before the guilt.

Name: The Casket of Kindness
Description: It holds every favor you never returned.
Effect: +1 Hope, lose 1 item if inventory not empty

Name: The Sleeping Choir
Description: They dream of the day you join them.

Name: Throne of Melted Faces
Description: They weep wax. They smile anyway.
Effect: Gain item: Wax Crown (+1 Hope, -1 Sanity when worn)

Name: The Hungry Cot
Description: The cradle rocks. The teeth beneath it do too.

Name: The Vine of Apologies
Description: It wraps tighter with every sorry you didn’t mean.

Name: The Bleeding Mask
Description: It fits perfectly. Too perfectly.
Effect: -1 Sanity, gain item: Face of Another

Name: The Watcher’s Gallows
Description: Something unseen judges every move you make.

Name: The Garden of Apologies
Description: The flowers wilt when you speak.
Effect: Gain item: Regret Seed (revive one destroyed item)

Name: The Gutless Choir
Description: They sing only from memory. And now they want yours.

Name: The Lullaby Tomb
Description: It hums a lullaby you recognize but can’t place.

Name: The Rotting Marriage
Description: Vows echo through the hollow rings.

Name: The Freezing Prayer
Description: You mouth words you don’t understand. Your breath crystallizes.

Name: The Nameless Choir
Description: They sing of everyone but you.

Name: The Shattered Stage
Description: No one claps. You bow anyway.

Name: The Puppeted Pilgrim
Description: It marches forever toward nowhere.

Name: The Candle-Melt Oracle
Description: Drips fall like fate. Burn or be buried.
Effect: -1 Health, gain item: Oracle Wick (once per game, cancel 1 effect)

Name: The Path of Remembered Crimes
Description: Each step recalls a different mistake.

Name: The Machine That Regrets
Description: It ticks, whirs, then sighs. You feel it too.
